resources.title: Original Writing practice · 20 prompts
resources.description: Original practice prompts modeled on the task formats in the existing library. Not official ETS material.

exercises.title: Original practice · Library workshop
exercises.prompt:
You want to attend a research workshop. Write an email to the librarian. In your email:
• Explain your research topic.
• Ask about available dates.
• Request preparation materials.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Room reservation
exercises.prompt:
You want to reserve a room for a club event. Write an email to the student center coordinator. In your email:
• Describe the event.
• Explain your room requirements.
• Ask about booking procedures.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Missed laboratory
exercises.prompt:
You want to make up a missed laboratory session. Write an email to your instructor. In your email:
• Explain your absence.
• Describe how you have caught up.
• Suggest a time to complete the work.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Volunteer schedule
exercises.prompt:
You want to change your volunteer schedule. Write an email to the volunteer coordinator. In your email:
• Explain the scheduling conflict.
• Offer two alternative times.
• Explain how you will finish your responsibilities.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Damaged equipment
exercises.prompt:
You want to report a borrowed laptop problem. Write an email to the technology desk. In your email:
• Describe the problem.
• Explain when it started.
• Request a repair or replacement.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Campus garden
exercises.prompt:
You want to propose a campus garden. Write an email to the sustainability coordinator. In your email:
• Explain its benefits.
• Suggest a suitable location.
• Offer to help organize volunteers.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Group project
exercises.prompt:
You want to resolve a delay in your group project. Write an email to a project teammate. In your email:
• Describe the unfinished task.
• Explain its effect on the deadline.
• Propose a fair division of work.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Internship information
exercises.prompt:
You want to learn about an internship. Write an email to a career adviser. In your email:
• Describe your interests.
• Ask about eligibility.
• Request help preparing your application.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Course materials
exercises.prompt:
You want to request an accessible course reading. Write an email to your professor. In your email:
• Identify the reading you cannot access.
• Describe the access problem.
• Ask for an alternative format.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Study exchange
exercises.prompt:
You want to prepare for a semester abroad. Write an email to an exchange coordinator. In your email:
• Describe your academic plans.
• Ask about housing.
• Request information about orientation.

Write in complete sentences.

exercises.title: Original practice · Recorded lectures
exercises.prompt:
Professor: Should universities provide recordings of every lecture?

Student 1: Recordings help students review difficult concepts.

Student 2: Students may stop attending classes.

Contribute to the discussion in your own words. Express and support your opinion and engage with at least one student's idea. Aim for at least 100 words.

exercises.title: Original practice · Public transport

Student 2: Improving service quality is more useful than eliminating fares.

Contribute to the discussion in your own words. Express and support your opinion and engage with at least one student's idea. Aim for at least 100 words.
